title: Packet Lens
summary: Turns a raw pcap into a ranked list of things worth looking at.
description: A triage tool for network captures. It reassembles flows, extracts protocol-level features, and scores each flow against a gradient-boosted model trained on labelled intrusion traffic. The output is a short list with reasons attached, not a dashboard of everything. Built after spending too many evenings scrolling Wireshark by hand.

title: Logsmith
summary: Generates realistic attack telemetry so detection rules can be tested before they ship.
description: Detection rules are usually written against a handful of real incidents and hope. Logsmith replays parameterised attack chains into a sandboxed host and captures the resulting logs, so a rule can be tested against a hundred variants of the same technique. Mapped to MITRE ATT&CK technique IDs.

title: Quiet Classifier
summary: Text classification that reports when it does not know.
description: A small transformer fine-tune wrapped in a calibrated abstention layer. Instead of forcing a label, it returns a confidence band and defers anything below threshold to a human queue. Built for a moderation workflow where a wrong answer costs more than a slow one.

title: Driftwatch
summary: Watches a deployed model's inputs and says when the world has moved.
description: Monitors feature distributions against a training-time baseline and raises a signal when drift crosses a statistically meaningful threshold, with a per-feature breakdown of what changed. Deliberately boring: one process, one SQLite file, no cluster.

title: Hardening Notes
summary: A reproducible baseline for locking down a fresh Linux server.
description: An Ansible role built from the CIS benchmark, with every deviation documented and justified rather than silently dropped. Includes a verification playbook that reports the current state of a host against the baseline.

title: Gradient Leak Lab
summary: Reconstructs training samples from shared gradients in a federated setup.
description: A teaching implementation of gradient inversion attacks against federated learning, plus measurements of how much each common defence actually costs in accuracy. Written to check whether the defences I kept reading about hold up.
